text: Emiliard Daillon is one of the survivors of the Bloodfiend attack on the town of Moira's Hope.
Emilien is a Breton member of Captain Currod's crew found aboard The Tava's Bounty, docked in Koeglin Village. He can be found lying injured on the quarterdeck. He has no unique dialogue.

Eminelya is a member of Queen Ayrenn's entourage in who lost herself in the Glister Vale along with the rest of her group. rewards Kilt of the Fractured Mind (part of the Queen's Elegance set) upon completing Depths of Madness.
The Elytra Hatchling is a creature in . It is a form of Elytra.
The Elytra Soldier is a creature in . It is a form of Elytra.
Elurmeril is an Altmer blacksmith. He sells his wares at his shop, The Better Blacksmith, in Abah's Landing.
Elneri Drothas is a Dunmer tailor. She sells her wares at her store, Coastal Clothiers and Fabrics, in Anvil.
Eminaire is an Altmer scholar conducting research on ancient Ayleid tablets out of her camp located west of Elden Root.
Eluza Derre is a Breton residing inside her house in Northpoint.
Emilien Sele is a Breton warrior found at the Lion Guard Redoubt in Glenumbra.

Emeric of Cumberland was the Breton High King of High Rock during the Interregnum. Emeric was the founder of the Daggerfall Covenant, one of the strongest alliances in the province of Tamriel. Emeric is a brilliant individual, well-rounded in trading, speechcraft, and the military. He was also the founder of the Cumberland Dynasty.
Elynea Lathdar is a Dunmer commoner residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is located within Lathdar's House. She has no unique dialogue.
Emelin the Returned is a Nereid found in Underpall Cave. She is one of the two delve bosses of the dungeon.
Emonarel is a Altmer who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Elsoreth is an Bosmer residing in Rethelmir's House in Russafeld, Summerset.

Elnis Admand is a Breton woodworker located southwest of Piukanda, chopping lumber near Akovor's home. He and his brother, Yves Admand, along with Jaram and Lejka, comprise the Admand Brothers Lumber Works.
Elsweyr Guard is a generic Khajiit guards residing in the city of Rimmen.
Eltrys Frasoric is a Breton beggar found near the Lilmoth Wayshrine. He has no unique dialogue.
Emah-Ral is a Dunmer Ashlander found in the Zainab camp outside Kudanat Mine in Vvardenfell.
Elnis is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild found in Spindleclutch I in Glenumbra.
Elvali is a Guar belonging to Ral Savani. She is found by Beem-Jee and his cart at Whisker-Twitch Trading Hut in Kragenmoor.
Elsenekka is a Nord priest residing in Solitude. She can be found walking on an elevation next to the Hall of the Dead.
Emoryan is a Breton residing in the Old Goat Inn, located inside Alcaire Castle.

Eraamion is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild who resides in Caldera. He offers several spells, including Alteration, Destruction, Illusion and Mysticism spells. However, Eraamion will not work with vampires.

Eplear Camoran was a Bosmer king remembered as the founder of the Camoran Dynasty in year zero of the First Era (1E 0). The establishment of the Camoran Dynasty marked both the beginning of the First Era and the official recording of historical time in Tamriel. His success in uniting the often divided Bosmeri clans is celebrated as one of the greatest political and military achievements in the history of Tamriel.
Endring is a Bosmer Enforcer who resides in the House Telvanni stronghold of Tel Branora. He is specifically tasked with guarding Trerayna Dalen.
Ennah is a Redguard living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni.
Endris Dilmyn is a Dunmer commoner and a Sixth House Cult sleeper. He lives alone in his shack on the docks of Khuul during the day, and is a messenger for Dagoth Ur at night.
Emusette Bracques is a Breton living in Tel Aruhn. She is a Journeyman in the Mages Guild. She offers skill training in Resoration, Alteration, and Destruction.

Enar Dralor is a Dunmer Buoyant Armiger living in the Ghostgate. There, he can be encountered on the lower level of the Tower of Dusk. He is a member of the Tribunal Temple as well as of the Buoyant Armigers, a militaristic division of the temple.

Enman Septim was the middle son of Uriel Septim VII and Caula Voria. He was considered the "most handsome" of the heirs, if well into his middle-age by Cyrodilic standards. His hair was flecked with gray and slightly receding, lines, some deep, etched across his face. But his eyes were bright and his jaw-line and the figure of his body were strong. When negotiating with King Helseth, Enman wasted no time in beginning the frank discussion, saying "The Empire wants its bases in Vvardenfell recovered. We want additional bases throughout the mainland and the island. We want the first child of your union [Helseth and Vendama] to marry into the Imperial family." Helseth agreed to these terms. He w
Enrion is an Altmer mage and a fugitive who is hiding in Bloodmayne Cave. He is a criminal who broke out of the Bravil prison with Hlofgar, Dreet-Lai, and Ashanta.
Engorm is a Bosmer alchemist who worships the Daedric Prince Sanguine. Engorm has devoted his life to Sanguine and can be found at the Shrine of Sanguine.
Eponis Vinipter is a hostile Imperial warrior and smuggler who resides in Shurinbaal.
Endrast is a deceased Bosmer whose body is located in the Alftand Animonculory.
Ennis is a Redguard farmer in Rorikstead in Whiterun Hold. He tends to his farm with the help of Reldith. They make a profit not only from the crops, but also from selling their cattle's manure.
Endarie is an Altmer shopkeeper in Solitude. She co-owns Radiant Raiment with her sister Taarie.

Endon is a Redguard silversmith who lives with his family in the city of Markarth, the capital of The Reach. He will become a Fence for the Dragonborn after the quest "Silver Lining" has been completed for the Thieves Guild.

Ennodius Papius is a recluse who camps just west of Anga's Mill, along Yorgrim River. He was once the mill's proud miller but has since left his profession and spiraled into paranoia, thinking someone is out to get him. It is unclear why Papius became paranoid.
Eno Hlaalu is a Dunmer who is located beneath the arena in Vivec. As Grandmaster of the Morag Tong, he is the only person that the Nerevarine can speak to if they wish to join the society.
Ennoc is a Breton miner. He works in Left Hand Mine and lives in the Miner's Barracks outside the mine.
Emul-Ran is a Dunmer Ashlanders hunter found in the wilderness south of Ahemmusa Camp, in the waterlines of the Grazelands region.

Enar Releth is a Dunmer sorcerer, and a member of House Telvanni, residing in the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora. When Baladas Demnevanni has been convinced to become a councilor, Enar will become the mouth of Baladas.
Endar Drenim is a Dunmer who can be found in the Tel Naga Upper Tower in Sadrith Mora. He is a member of House Telvanni.

Endase Avel is a Dunmer mage residing in the Upper Tower of Tel Aruhn. She is a member of House Telvanni holding the rank of Wizard. If asked about the topic "Telvanni councilors," she will hand the Nerevarine a copy of the Brown Book of 3E 426.
Endroni Dalas is a Dunmer Ordinator who resides in Ald Daedroth, Right Wing.

Endryn Llethan is a Dunmer monk and a member of the Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Vivec, Temple Canton. Endryn is Master of the Temple of Vivec City. He can be found in the eastern room of Vivec, High Fane. As Temple master, he provides duties to the Nerevar for advancement within the Temple.
Endul Rothandus is a Dunmer pauper who resides in the Waistworks of the Telvanni Canton.

Engaer is a Bosmer mercenary who lives in Sadrith Mora, at the Tel Naga Upper Tower. He swears loyalty to Neloth and House Telvanni. The Upper Tower can only be accessed via a levitate spell or potion. Engaer is at the top level behind the northern Golden Door, which is locked and trapped (lock level: 20).
Enjineis a hostile Redguard warrior and smuggler who resides in Shurinbaal. She is one of the two leaders, the other being Daroder Helni.

Engar Ice-Mane is a Nord warrior who resides in Skaal Village. He has been accused of stealing furs from his neighbor. During the quest "The Skaal Test of Wisdom," he asks the Nerevarine to help him clear his name.
Engar is a Nordic carriage driver added by . He is available for hire through the steward at Windstad Manor.
Eno Romari is a Dunmer priest and founder of the End of Times Cult who resides in the district of Godsreach, Mournhold. He believes that the Daedra are going to destroy the world.
Er-Jaseen is an Argonian Soul Shriven in the Wailing Prison. He holds a door closed with two other soul shriven, allowing the Vestige to escape with Lyris Titanborn.
Ena is a Redguard warrior and smuggler who resides in the cave of Mannammu. She is a member of the Verethi Gang and is the first enemy encountered in Mannammu.
Endemel Ancelet is a Breton enchanter residing in the city of Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Envoy Darima is a Redguard, residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. She has an urgent message to deliver to the Duke Nathaniel, but she is refused entry into the city.
Emson is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Camp outside Alcaire Castle, in Stormhaven. He seems to be the chef for the soldiers.
Endarre was an Ayleid hero who set out to hide the Prismatic Crystal in . He recounted his experience in his log.
Eoram Elf-Speaker is a Nord found inside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Endoriell is a Bosmer guild trader residing in the city of Mournhold, Deshaan. She can be found selling her goods at the Mourner's Market in the Plaza of the Gods.
Ennemond is a Breton mystic selling his wares at Blue Serpent's Soul Gems in the town of Bergama.
Ennas at-Aswala is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel. She is the stablemaster working at the Red Feathers Horse and Bridle stable.
Enri Onfroi is a Breton leatherworker residing in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Enaring is a character residing in The Waxing Crescent, in the city of Rawl'kha.
Enneh at-Tarin is a Redguard residing in the Alik'r Desert city of Bergama.
Endless-Belly is a tame Guar in that resides at The Gray Mire. It stays in a croft with two other guars, pony guar Comes-When-Called and bantam guar Small-One.
Ensi is a Khajiit working at the Oak and Crosier in Chorrol.
Enak is a Khajiit and the assistant of Brelynd Verano. He is currently trying to gain access to the ruins of Anga.
Enathorn is a Bosmer member of the Thalmor found in their headquarters in Woodhearth.
Enda is an Altmer from Auridon who traveled to Grahtwood to look for her missing husband.
Endarwe is an Altmer mage trying to stop the Worm Cult from resurrecting a powerful Ayleid king in the ruins of Rulanyil's Fall. He is the leader of the Merethic Society.
Endrothir is a mystic owner of Endrothir's Gemporium in Dune.
Eneriell is a Bosmer refugee of the destroyed village of Pell's Gate.
Engiroth is a Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful found in his tent at the Falinesti Winter Site.
Englor is a Bosmer soldier of the Aldmeri Dominion posted at Fort Grimwatch.
Englornith is a Bosmer found in Nimalten. She has no unique dialogue.
Engor is a Bosmer who can be found northeast of the Cave of Broken Sails in Grahtwood. He is one of the remaining members of Captain Linwen's crew currently aiding her in overtaking a mutiny.
Enis al-Antiphyllos is a Redguard noble attending to Count Hosni at-Tura's party at his estate in Stormhaven.
Ensign Monwe is a member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is located at the battlefield in the Abecean Sea.

Ensign Qraalel is a Maormer soldier and member of the Sea Vipers found captive at Eagle's Strand. He is bound within a tower, overseen by a number of troops, and is suspected to be causing the magical storm cloud found within.
Entelator is a Bosmer patron of The Watch House in Davon's Watch found sitting down at the end of a bed muttering sad thoughts to himself.
Enthonor is a Bosmer alchemist residing in the town of Cormount, Grahtwood. He can be found at his shop, Enthonor's Effusions, selling his wares.
Eofel is a Nord bard performing at The Horker's Tusk Tavern in Ivarstead. She cannot be interacted with.
Endavar is a Redguard scholar found wandering around the docks of Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Enrick Lateur is a Breton innkeeper found offering his services in Enrick's Public House in Anvil, Gold Coast.

Count Ephrem Benirus, also known as the Imperial Dragon, was an Imperial Prefect and ruler of Anvil during the Interregnum. He attempted to invade Kvatch, but was defeated on multiple occasions by Carolus Aquilarios, and was eventually usurped by Pirate Queen Fortunata ap Dugal.
Engail was a Bosmer residing in Deepwoods. Her body can be found on the borders of the village, where she was attacked and killed by wild senche.
Engariel is a Bosmer member of the Star-Gazers. She is found in their observatory in Belkarth.
Emstagg is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Enasourr is a Dunmer Ashlander warrior residing in Urshilaku Camp on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Enethrin is a Bosmer commoner residing inside Ciireriath's Home in the town of Bramblebreach in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood.

Empress Tavia was the last Empress of the Reman Dynasty and consequently married to the last Emperor of the Reman Dynasty, Reman III. In 1E 2899, her husband suspected her of treason, and therefore sent her to be imprisoned and held in Castle Giovesse, located in Gideon, Black Marsh, for fear of revolution. It is thought that upon her death, Empress Tavia's skull was dipped in gold and encrusted with gems. This skull would later go on to be known as the "Giovessen Skull," and became a valuable artifact among collectors. For a time it was also rumored that the skull was simply a clever fake, and actually belonged to some long-dead Breton prisoner in Hammerfell's dungeons. This doubt, however,
Entekkar the Soulgorger is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Endolale is an Altmer bard singing and playing the lute on the ground floor of the Anchors Aweigh Inn in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset.
Endocar is an Altmer who can be found in a vanguard camp near Sea Keep in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Ephen, also known as S'ephen, is a Dunmer who lived during the First Era in Morrowind.
Ena White-Eye is a Nord in and a smuggler residing southwest of Dragon Bridge, Western Skyrim.
Eponis Muspidius is an Imperial academic residing near the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth.
Engine Garrison's Centurion is a Dwarven Centurion of the Engine Garrison in located in Darkshade Caverns II in the Dwemer city of Rkugamz guarding the entrance to the Great Engine.
Enraged Spriggan is a creature in that is a part of the Forgotten Seasons Creation Club content.
Enlizanev is a Spiderkith found in Fargrave. She plays dice with Naraman.

Erene Llenim is a Dunmer commoner and fisherman who lives and works in the village of Seyda Neen. He lives in a small shack in the west side of town. He spends most of his time standing around outside, drinking. He owed 78 drakes in taxes to Processus Vitellius, which he paid on time.
Erranil is an Altmer Guild Guide in the Mages Guild in Ald'ruhn. She serves as the Guild Guide for the Ald'ruhn Mages Guild.
Ernand Thierry is a Breton alchemist who resides within the Mages Guild in Caldera. He offers several different potions for sale, as well as many different ingredients.
Estirdalin is an Altmer mage who lives in Balmora. She can be found in the Balmora Mages Guild. She offers both spells, and training in the Schools of illusion, destruction, and alteration.

Esbern is an Elder Nord and one of the last remaining Blades, the powerful order of knights and warriors who served as bodyguards to the Septim Emperors, who were also known throughout Tamriel as the eyes and ears of the Emperors and Empresses.
Eronor is a Dunmer herder residing in the Weynon House in the chapel of Weynon Priory. He is a lay brother and is in charge of the sheep and horses.
Erissare Arenim is an Altmer commoner living in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City.
Estinan is a Bosmer enforcer living in Tel Branora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni, and guards Trerayna Dalen.
Ervyna Hlervu is a Dunmer hunter living in Tel Branora, Morrowind.

Ervesa Romandas is a Dunmer living in Molag Mar, Morrowind. She is a Buoyant Armiger and novice member of the Tribunal Temple who resides at the Armigers Stronghold in the city's waistworks. Ervesa does not offer any services and is not involved in any quests.

Erval is a Bosmer Commoner living in the Ascadian Isles region of Vvardenfell. He wears common clothing, and lives alone in his house, a small home in north-west Pelagiad. Erval is not involved in any quests and doesn't provide any unique dialogue.
Ertius Fulbenus is an Imperial warrior living in Gnisis in the West Gash. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.

Erline Lirrian is a widow who can be found in Bradon Lirrian's House near the west wall of Bruma. She was the wife of Bradon Lirrian, who was accused of being a vampire and later slain by a vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas.

Erthor is a Bosmer sorcerer found in Bleak Flats Cave. While he is a member of the Mages Guild, he is not allowed to do his research in Skingrad Mages Guild due to a "Scamp incident" the previous year.

Estelle Renoit is a Breton who sells books at Renoit's Books in Chorrol. She offers a wide selection, including the entire set of Biography of Barenziah, Brief History of the Empire and The Real Barenziah. She also sells the powerful Stormrider Scroll. Estelle has 600 to barter.
Ernest Manis is a Breton and the proprietor of The Foaming Flask, an inn in the Talos Plaza District of the Imperial City.
Eridor is a Bosmer and leader of the band of Vampire hunters encountered in the quest "Information at a Price." He is the only member that the Hero can have a conversation with.
Ervona Barys is a Dunmer battlemage living in Ebonheart, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison. She is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Erina Jeranus is an Imperial innkeeper at the West Weald Inn in Skingrad. She has 50 available for bartering and rents beds for 20 .
Eris Senim is a Dunmer priest who replaces Uravasa Othrelas (if he dies) after the completion of the official plug-in. Eris offers basic Speechcraft training and sells spells.

Errandil is an Altmer and the only living saint of Arkay. He can be found at The Great Chapel of Arkay, located in Cheydinhal. With installed, he will be found dead in the chapel, having been killed by Umaril's forces.

Et'Ada, also called the "Original Spirits," are the forces perceived and revered by the mortals as gods or spirits. To humans, these et'Ada are the Gods and Demons. To the Aldmer, the Aedra (Aldmeri translation is "our ancestors") and Daedra (Aldmeri translation is "not our ancestors"). The Aedra and Daedra came to be once Lorkhan convinced/tricked the Original Spirits (et'Ada) to create Mundus. The Daedra are the et'Ada who did not take part in the creation of Mundus to retain their power. The Aedra are the et'Ada who remained during the creation of Mundus, thus giving away a significant amount of their power.
Esdrufus Harsinia is an Imperial agent who resides in Ashinabi. He is hostile towards the Nerevarine, but if they can manage to speak to him, he will offer training to them.

Erik the Slayer, initially referred to as Erik, is a Nord who lives in the Frostfruit Inn of Rorikstead. Erik is the son of Rorikstead's innkeeper, Mralki, and works as a farmer around the small community, although he dreams of a life of adventure.
Erdi is a Nord maid at the Blue Palace of Solitude. She works alongside Una.
Erikur is a Nord warrior residing at his house in Solitude. He serves as Thane to Elisif the Fair, the Jarl of Solitude. Melaran, a mage who specializes in Alteration, serves as his housecarl.
Etienne Rarnis is a Breton thief and a member of the Thieves Guild found imprisoned inside the Thalmor Embassy.
Evette San is a Nord merchant who lives in Solitude. During the day, she can be found near the well in Solitude or in her house. She sells spiced wine, and is the only vendor to regularly do so.

Erj is a deceased Breton conjurer and scholar in who was interested in the Dwemer. His corpse is encountered within Nchuand-Zel's armory. His journal reveals that he was looting the ruins, and planned to buy a castle with what riches he found within.

Eris is a Nord sailor and part of the Red Wave crew, which can be found next to the East Empire Company Warehouse. She is young, calm and cheerful. She has long, blond hair, tanned skin and war paint over her left eye.
Erith is a Breton child. She is the daughter of Daighre and can be found outside Left Hand Mine outside Markarth. When she has been adopted by the Dragonborn, her dog Torom, comes with her.

Erlendr was a Nord warrior. He is a hero, and his ghost can be found inside the Hall of Valor in Sovngarde. He, along with Nikulas and Hunroor, was turned into a stone pillar at Brodir Grove by the wizard Grimkell while searching for Sovngarde. Ulfgar the Unending later avenged them by killing Grimkell. Erlendr and his companions eventually did find Sovngarde.
Erver Devani is a Dunmer barbarian who resides in the village of Deepwallow on the Dementia side of Shivering Isles.
Erur-Dan was one of the former Incarnates of the Nerevarine. As a failed incarnate, he resides in the Cavern of the Incarnate to help the present Incarnate of the Nerevarine during the main quest.
Erer Darothril is a Dunmer Mage who resides in Morrowind. He is found in the city of Sadrith Mora, inside the Dirty Muriel's Cornerclub.
Ereven Velas is a Dunmer witchhunter who resides in the Arena of Rotheran.
Erirvase Drinith is a Dunmer who resides in the Hlaalu Temple in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue, and is not involved in any quests.
Eris Telas is a Dunmer apothecary, merchant, and member of Tribunal Temple, who resides in the Vivec, Temple Canton.
Ernse Llervu is a Dunmer monk and a master trainer who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton. She is found behind a locked door in The Abbey of St. Delyn the Wise.
Ervas Aradil is a Dunmer warrior who resides in the Ministry of Truth.

Ethasi Rilvayn is a Dunmer Nightblade who resides in Balmora. Ethasi is the leader of the Morag Tong branch in Balmora. She handles giving Writs calling for the deaths of targets to lower ranking members of the guild.
Ethys Savil is a Dunmer nightblade who resides in the Black Shalk Cornerclub, in the Foreign Quarter Lower Waistworks of Vivec. He is a member of House Hlaalu.
Evesa Omalas is a Dunmer pilgrim residing in Holamayan. She is a member of the Dissident Priests.
Eradan is a hostile Bosmer battlemage and worshiper who resides at the Daedric shrine Addadshashanammu.
Erissare is an Altmer sorcerer. She can be found in a small cave named Aharnabi.

Erna the Quiet is a Nord commoner who can be found together with her lover Brandr next to the Isild River during the quest "A Woman Scorned." If she is killed by the Nerevarine, Brandr will become instantly hostile.
Ettiene is a Hagraven found in . She is the sister of Isobel and Fallaise.
Erundil is an Altmer sorcerer found in Morrowind. He is holding the Ring of Sanguine Unseen Wisdom, an extravagant ring blessed by Sanguine that is wanted by the Morag Tong.
Ereel-Lei is an Argonian slave for sale. She is held in a cage in the slave market in Sadrith Mora until sold.
Eraldil is a Bosmer savant residing in the Hlaalu Waistworks in Vivec City. She is the recipient of a love letter from Gadayn Andarys.
Eutei is an Argonian slave residing in Saturan. She can be found behind a locked door working with five other slaves.
Erradan is a Bosmer acrobat, and a member of House Telvanni residing in Shishara.
Evessa is a Dunmer patron of the Screaming Mermaid in Port Hunding.
Erik Snowmead is a Nord alchemist. He sells his wares at his apothecary, The Fragrant Fungus, on the Artisans' Row in Davon's Watch.
Erind Len is a Breton scholar and member of the Mages Guild found in their camp in the Glenumbra Moors, High Rock.

Eshaba is a Khajiit member of the Eyes of the Queen. She poses as a regular merchant selling her wares at the Guard's Forge in Vulkhel Guard, which in turn grants her access to information from her customers.
Erronwe is an Altmer farmer residing in Phaer in Auridon. She has a daughter named Elenya.
Eryeril is an Altmer residing in Phaer, Auridon, located in his house.
Essaldur is an Altmer commoner in who resides in the town of Phaer, Auridon.
Erwan Castille is a Breton who is found in the Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. He is a refugee from Camlorn.
Erthaenir is a Bosmer magus and member of the Mages Guild residing in the local guildhall of Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Erendil is an Altmer soldier who can be found in Eagle's Strand in Khenarthi's Roost.
Ervalir is a Bosmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. He can be seen to be giving what appears to be a guided tour to 3 persons from outside of Grahtwood.
Estien Arnese is a Breton residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Esladir is a Bosmer residing in the city of Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Erilthil is a Bosmer residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Eveline Vette is a Breton residing in Bad Man's Hallows, Glenumbra. When first met she is trapped by the roots of the tree in the Bad Man's tunnels.
Estilldo is an Altmer residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. She is a guild trader, and has her stand at the Guild Traders market.
Escalette Beanique is Breton residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. She is walking back and forth in the southern part of the city, claiming that she is not drunk although she visibly is.
Ervis Verano is a Dunmer crusader found within Helseth's Chambers in the Royal Palace of Mournhold. He is a member of the Royal Guard, and as such wears a full set of Royal Guard Armor.
Eringor is a Bosmer member of the Brackenleaf's Briars, residing in the Grahtwood town of Brackenleaf.
Erunirai is a Khajiit found at the Temple of Two-Moons Dance.
Eryon is an Altmer found in the Ezduiin Undercroft in Auridon, and is a member of the Mages Guild. He cannot be directly interacted with, except to rescue from Uricantar's spell.
Eurnus the Baker is a Dunmer provisioner found in the Residential District of Mournhold.
Esqoo is an Argonian guar-herder residing in the town of Dhalmora.
Eraegaer the Kill-Happy is a Bosmer member of the Undaunted residing in the city of Marbruk.
Erinel is a Bosmer residing in the city of Marbruk. She is betrothed to Laurosse, an Altmer.
Ethad-sa is a Khajiit grocer. He sells his wares at his stall, A Fresh Start, at the marketplace in Riften.
Erunor is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, Greenshade. Erunor is married to Laniriel.
Eudeline Aalart is a Breton mystic residing in the city of Hallin's Stand.
Erandil is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild residing in the city of Kragenmoor.
Erathrin is a Bosmer merchant working at The Stout Elf's Cart and Pastry in the city of Rawl'kha.
Ereel-Maxath is an Argonian Moneylender residing in the Wayrest Outlaws Refuge in the city of Wayrest.
Estayne Antieve is a Breton residing in the city of Wayrest.
Ethlinor is a Bosmer residing in the Marbruk Outlaws Refuge.
Ernele is a Redguard residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Erlnorr Snow-Mane is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Eralgor is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Marbruk.
Eranamo is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance found in the ruins of Quendeluun.
Eraral-dro is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. He is in charge of their operations at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Erdama is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan. She is found at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Erekka is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. She is found inside the barracks in Fort Amol.
Ergrod the Cook is a Nord chef. He sells his wares at his stall, The Practical Traveler, at Jorunn's Stand.
Erila Morvayn is a Dunmer found in Davon's Watch. She can be seen on the bridge leading of the city, sometimes talking with Darasken. She cannot be interacted with.

Ernabi is a deceased Khajiit whose body can be found in The Cave of Trophies. She was killed when her and her mate Ahirunz attempted to find shelter inside the cav but instead were greeted by the daedra residing there.
Ernirus Cine is a Breton who moved to Vlastarus from Daggerfall with his husband, Therich Rorielle.
Eronthor is a Bosmer outlaw residing at the refuge in the city of Vulkhel Guard, Auridon.
Erranenen is a Dunmer bard who can be found near the road west from Alten Corimont in Shadowfen. He lost his lute in a bet with Akishan.
Errannie is an Altmer traveling merchant found on her way to Mathiisen, Auridon.
Erranza is a Khajiit ghost found in the White Rose Prison. In death, she seeks help to be reunited with the rest of her family by burying her remains outside the prison walls.
Erthalmoth is a Bosmer slave found in Port Hunding, just east of the Headman Bhosek's Palace. He has no unique dialogue.
Erunien is an Altmer member of the First Auridon Marines found in Dawnbreak.
Ervyla Hlaalu is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu found in Narsis. She may also be found at a campfire with Vlaasti near the Davon's Watch Wayshrine in Stonefalls.
Ervynu is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Alten Corimont.
Erwan Tauzin is a Breton mystic with the Daggerfall Covenant selling his wares at the Armory Merchants at the Northern High Rock Gate.
Eryarion is an Altmer inn worker from Haven who got lost in the nearby swamps.
Erymil is an Altmer traveling merchant found on the road east of Greenwater Cove in Auridon.
Esan is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. He is one of many who helps the Lunar Champion retake Dune from the Stonefire Cult.
Eshmini-ma is a Khajiit residing in the town of Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Esmaeel is a deceased Redguard whose body can be found inside a cell in the Obsidian Scar, Rivenspire. He was married to Lashgikh before his death.
Essaneth is a Bosmer brewer selling her wares at her store, The Green Leaf, in Cormount.
Estelline is a Breton outlaw found in Port Hunding. She can be found hunting for treasure on the beach. She has no unique dialogue.

Etienne Delrusc is a Breton noble found in Daggerfall. He has got himself caught in the middle of a feud pertaining to Francine Chatillon's dog. He can be found opposite the Daggerfall Fighters Guild, walking around the plaza.
Euthar Neckbender is a Nord woodworker. He sells his wares at his stall, Neckbender's, at the marketplace in Riften.
Eutropia Dorso is an Imperial patron of The Sloshing Tankard in Northpoint.
Ervyni is a Dunmer worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Ereluin is a Bosmer chef residing in the city of Longhaven, Greenshade, where she owns her own house.
Eveli Sharp-Arrow is a Bosmer adventurer found in Wrothgar. She has never been outside of Valenwood before, and has little experience in the rest of Tamriel.
Eralyn Dour is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.
Erthelgor is a Bosmer outlaw residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Erengor is a Bosmer member of the Thieves Guild found in the Thieves Den in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.

Eugenie Cergend is a Breton commoner residing in the Saint Delyn Plaza on the upper level of the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue and is not involved in any quests or unique interactions.
Erluramar is an Altmer guild trader selling her wares in Kvatch.
Erraduure is an Ayleid spirit found within the Reliquary of Stars.
Errafinwe is an Altmer gambling at The Winking Jackal in Bergama.
Eukkaneeus is an Argonian residing at the Landreau House in Daggerfall.
Erimroth is a Bosmer found with his companion Miruin Burr-Hair at their campsite at various locations in Alik'r Desert. The Vestige can light their fire as part of the Lightbringer achievement.
Erenthiel is a Bosmer found in the Shadows Crawl. She is one of the last surviving members of the Driladan Clan.
Escaped Prisoner is an unused Nord in . He wears a roughspun tunic and a pair of footwraps.
Erebil Drel is a Dunmer merchant. He sells his wares at his stall, The Corner Counter, in Kvatch.
Erivase Marvos is a Dunmer residing inside Panundus Didatus's house in Kvatch.
Ervas Givyn is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Kagesh Tribe. He is found at their camp near Iliath Temple.

Erina Glaucia is an Imperial found at a wayshrine of Akatosh located in the Gold Coast. She is sitting on a rug with her husband, Antus Glaucia. After completion of "Pious Intervention," neither she, nor her husband, can be found.
Etira Gravius is a deceased Imperial. Her corpse is found within Hrota Cave.
Eutropia Senyan is an Imperial who can be found near Vilia's House in Kvatch. She can sometimes be seen talking to Vodiaka Planicus. She cannot be interacted with.
Eustacia is the daughter of an oracle who can be found within the camp in the city of Dawnstar. She was tasked with aiding the player by Governor Vinticae prior to their arrival.
Esmond Montgrun is a Breton found in Rawl'kha. He has no unique dialogue.
Eraven Onthim is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni residing in the Council House of Sadrith Mora.
Erikar Five-Blades is a Nord armsman of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in the Saint Delyn Waistworks of Vivec City.
Erning Snowlost is a Nord found at his camp near Aleswell Farm in Cyrodiil.
Estate Mender is a generic character residing in the Gold Coast.
Eryob was the overseer of the Skraws working on Umbriel's sump. He had bushy red eyebrows.
Ernse Eldri is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.

Etsabeeh is an Argonian found at the northern part of the Shimmerene Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. Although he has the merchant class, he does not have any items for sale. He has no unique dialogue.
Esterdel is an Altmer found outside of Archon's Grove on the island of Summerset. Niralin is his betrothed.
Euraxia Tharn is the younger half-sister of Abnur Tharn and aunt of Empress Clivia Tharn.
Erilthel is a Bosmer mender of the Thieves Guild who can be found in the Eton Nir Grotto in Summerset, and later at Blackrose Prison in Murkmire and Borderwatch in Blackwood.
Eranion is a Bosmer who appears outside of Rimmen in Northern Elsweyr. He is an ex-gladiator turned furnisher at the Battlegrounds Housing Goods, part of the Rimmen Battlegrounds Camp.
